function: CSI compression at the UE and reconstruction at the BS for FDD massive MIMO, assisted by downlink channel covariance information extrapolated from uplink (p. 1-3).
system: FDD massive MIMO with OFDM, BS ULA with 32 antennas, 1024 subcarriers, single-antenna UE, no RIS; indoor 5.1/5.3 GHz and semi-urban outdoor 260/300 MHz (p. 2, 4).
method: CNN (SqueezeNet) and Transformer encoder, covariance network, and decoder; trained end-to-end with MSE loss and Adam; no federated, meta, or transfer learning (p. 3-4).
data_channel: COST2100: indoor (5.1 GHz UL, 5.3 GHz DL) and semi-urban outdoor (260 MHz UL, 300 MHz DL); random split, 100,000 training and 20,000 test samples (p. 4).
test_conditions: Random train-test split within each COST2100 environment, compression ratios 32-256; covariance and uplink errors with SNR 0-20 dB are tested in Fig. 4 (p. 4-5).
baselines: CsiNet, TransNet, UpAid-FBnet, DualNet-ABS, all learned; ablated CovNet with conventional FFN and CNN; no classical method (p. 4-5).
metrics: NMSE in dB in the angle-delay domain versus compression ratio and uplink SNR; FLOPs (p. 4-5).
complexity: Table I (p. 5): CovNet 35.15M FLOPs at CR 32 down to 34.92M at CR 256; TransNet 35.50M-35.27M, CsiNet 3.69M-3.46M, UpAid-FBnet 16.97M-16.80M.
openness: none; no code or data link, the data are generated with the COST2100 model (p. 4).
q1_support: p. 4: "We generate two types of channel matrices by COST2100 channel model [18] for training and testing"; COST 2100 is a listed shared channel model.
q2_support: p. 4: "The datasets are randomly divided into training and testing sets, with 100,000 and 20,000 samples, respectively"; held-out part of the same data, no cross-environment test, and Fig. 4 only sweeps the covariance error.
q3_support: p. 4: "The presented CovNet is compared with CsiNet [9], UpAid-FBnet [12], DualNet-ABS [13], and the SOTA TransNet [10]"; all are learned, and LASSO, BM3D-AMP, and codebooks appear only in the introduction (p. 1).
q4_support: p. 4: "computation complexity measured by floating point operations (FLOPs)"; Table I (p. 5) lists 35.15M FLOPs for CovNet at CR 32.
q5_support: p. 4: "We generate two types of channel matrices by COST2100 channel model [18]"; the authors generate their own data, and no code link, data link, or public dataset is named.
notes: Included letter, area 2 (CSI feedback assisted by covariance information). Table I was read from the page image because the text extraction omits its numbers. q3 is 0 because every compared method is learned. q5 is 0 because the COST2100 data are generated by the authors without a link, so the reviewer may confirm. The claim of generalization across environments (p. 4) rests only on separate indoor and outdoor results, not on a cross-environment test.
